video_title: The Infamous LeBron-Heat Cookie Story - Will Miami Make It Up To Him?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's arrival in Miami and the Heat's infamous press conference
quotes.excerpt: It gets remembered not five, not six, not seven. But it was pretty badass.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The interesting thing about this is that when LeBron came to Miami, the night of the decision, the people who knew first were the pilots. They had two planes at the Westchester County Airport in New York, and the pilots had to know where to fly. The pilots actually knew he was going to Miami. Remember, the night after the decision is when they had that big shindig down there, where they all, which by the way, you have to admit, was pretty, it gets remembered not five, not six, not seven. But it was pretty badass. The stage, it was a show. As far as introductory press conferences go, it was definitely the most memorable I've ever seen.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: I mean it was a show. It was there was, yeah, as far as introductory press conferences go, it was definitely the most memorable I've ever seen.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's decision to sign with the Heat was kept secret until the announcement
quotes.excerpt: We didn't know LeBron was coming back until after he announced it.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Dan Gilbert saying to me one time, he's like, we didn't know LeBron was coming back until after he announced it. The Lakers had some heads up, but it wasn't like the Lakers had 12-hour notice he was signing there. LeBron is going to say it and then inform the team or very close to it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: LeBron wants to make a splash when he makes it, when he changes teams. He wants the announcement, and that's what this whole thing is about right now. LeBron wants to make a splash.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Miami Heat's strict player weight monitoring and culture
quotes.excerpt: The Heat are fanatical about weight. Typically, players are weighed two or three times during the season.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Heat are fanatical about weight. Typically, players are weighed two or three times during the season, once at the beginning, once at the end. The Heat players are weighed like every day. I remember Shane Battier who told me once, if you have a big lunch, they know it, which is part of the reason that one of the most fascinating stories of LeBron's career was that he gained seven pounds during a game.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: That's one where I'm just not sure about the science behind that, but go on.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's weight fluctuations during his time with the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: LeBron weighed himself before and after every game when he was in Miami.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Mike Miller told me the story that LeBron, because in Miami they weigh these guys all the time, and LeBron started weighing himself. I guess he used to weigh himself before and after every game when he was in Miami. Maybe he still does, I don't know. And somehow, he weighed 261 before the game and 268 after the game or something like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: Maybe he put both feet on the scale the second time?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Pat Riley's decision to ban cookies from the team plane
quotes.excerpt: At some point, Riley ordered the cookies off the plane.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Heat were and are fanatical about all of that stuff. At some point, Riley ordered the cookies off the plane. And so LeBron, they're taking their flight, and LeBron goes to the, because what they typically do, they put, in the overhead bins, they fill the overhead bins with food and stuff, but they also will fill the overhead bins with like gum and fruit and snacks, which is, you know, the overhead bins like eye line for an NBA player. And LeBron went to go get his cookies and the cookies had been banned by Riley from the plane.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: I think it must have been one hell of a recipe.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's future and the uncertainty surrounding his next team
quotes.excerpt: It's not a comfortable thing to say that you don't know in our jobs.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I'm not counting on anybody. I don't have, it's not a comfortable thing to say that you don't know in our jobs, but it's the responsible thing. I assume at some level, maybe the ownership level, that there has been some conversations that maybe there is a very few set of people that know that it's moving in one direction or another.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: Do you think LeBron has made his decision and is now just plotting how it's announced?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's decision-making process and his penchant for showmanship
quotes.excerpt: Knowing his psychology, I would suspect that he has known for some time the direction he's heading.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Knowing LeBron like I know him, and I'm certainly not in his circle and I'm certainly not saying that I have special insight, but knowing his psychology, I would suspect that he has known for some time the direction he's heading. But obviously the decision is not finalized yet.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: And maybe the decision is finalized, and maybe he just want like again, part like he is a showman, and I think part of this is he wants to be very calculated on when, where, and how he releases this information to the world.
